[2] Length increases by 50%, width decreases by 20%.
[3] from [1],[2]: New length = 1.5 × original length, new width = 0.8 × original width.
[4] from [3]: New area = 1.5 × 0.8 = 1.2 times the original area, so increase is 20%.
ANSWER: 20
